description: This source file provides utility functions for network interface management, process handling, and system command execution in a C-based embedded or network system. It includes functions to set interface parameters, retrieve hardware and IP addresses, find process IDs, and manage service states, with conditional support for Wi-Fi management features.

methods.name: int vsystem(const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Executes a formatted system command and logs it to stderr.

methods.name: int sysctl_iface_set(const char * path,const char * ifname,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes content to a sysfs-like path, formatting the filename with interface name if provided.

methods.name: int iface_get_hwaddr(const char * ifname,char * mac,size_t size)
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware (MAC) address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: int iface_get_ipv4addr(const char * ifname,char * ipv4Addr,size_t size)
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: int is_iface_present(const char * ifname)
methods.description: Checks if a specified network interface is present and has an IPv4 address.

methods.name: int pid_of(const char * name,const char * keyword)
methods.description: Finds the process ID of a process with a given name and optional command line keyword.

methods.name: int serv_can_start(int sefd,token_t setok,const char * servname)
methods.description: Determines if a service can be started based on its current status retrieved via sysevent.

methods.name: int serv_can_stop(int sefd,token_t setok,const char * servname)
methods.description: Determines if a service can be stopped based on its current status retrieved via sysevent.

methods.name: void psmGet(void * bus_handle,char * pParamName,char * pParamValue,size_t len)
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the PSM datastore using CCSP APIs.

methods.name: void updateDhcpPoolData(void * bus_handle,char * pIndex,FILE * pFile)
methods.description: Updates DHCP pool data by retrieving configuration from PSM and writing it to a file.

ctags.pattern: /^int serv_can_start(int sefd, token_t setok, const char *servname)$/

ctags.pattern: /^int serv_can_stop(int sefd, token_t setok, const char *servname)$/

ctags.pattern: /^int sysctl_iface_set(const char *path, const char *ifname, const char *content)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * path,const char * ifname,const char * content)

ctags.pattern: /^void updateDhcpPoolData(void * bus_handle, char * pIndex, FILE * pFile)$/
